title: Near-death experience after poisoning: out-of-body travel and white light

tellings.quote: was delivered DOA to a clinic in pasel Germany from Austria and uh I had not had a heartbeat for almost 40 minutes

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that in 1970 he was poisoned in Austria and arrived dead at a clinic in Passau, Germany, with no heartbeat for almost 40 minutes. He says that during that time he left his body and saw a white light. To him it suggests the mind can go on outside the body.
